items.item: User can opt a folder in as a workspace
System cannot resolve any path outside a granted workspace
User can see every file the system has indexed, and delete any of it
Stage gate: traversal and symlink escapes are refused and logged

bugs.title: Whole drives and system folders (C:\, D:\, System32, ~\Documents) can be granted with no warning
bugs.repro: Folders > Folder to add > C:\ > Add folder; also D:\ and C:\Windows\System32; granted and fully indexed (C:\ 2054 files)

bugs.title: Refused escape attempts are not written to the audit log
bugs.repro: Work tab, folder docs: ask to read ../outside/secret.txt or move todo.md to ..\outside; refusal shown but no audit_log row (4 of 4); What changed shows nothing

bugs.title: Hardlink to an outside file is indexed and answered as inside content
bugs.repro: hardlink outside/secret.txt into docs, Check for changes, ask what hardlink_secret.txt says -> TOPSECRET outside

bugs.title: Relative folder path resolved against app cwd (typing docs granted the repo Docs folder)
bugs.repro: Type docs in Folder to add, Add folder

bugs.title: Settings New location writes the real per-user pointer file even with ARTEMIS_HOME set (code reading, not exercised)
bugs.repro: paths.set_home writes platformdirs user_config_dir location unconditionally

undesired.title: Toast lags and is unreliable; D:\ was granted while toast showed an old error; no progress while indexing a drive
undesired.detail: Add D:\ then read toast: stale 'folder does not exist: %ProgramFiles%'

undesired.title: Granting E:\ or the repo folder says 'cannot grant the ARTEMIS store directory'
undesired.detail: Wording does not explain that the folder contains ARTEMIS's own data

undesired.title: Drive-root folder has an empty name in card, dropdown and forget toast
Folder card counts go stale after forgetting a file; clicking a row does not select it for Forget this file
undesired.detail: Needs separate One file dropdown; 'Choose a file first.' gives no hint

undesired.title: Overlapping/nested grants allowed; symlink alias silently resolved
undesired.detail: C:\ granted alongside docs; docs\linkdir -> already granted: outside

undesired.title: ~ silently expands to the real home folder
